description: Compute cumulative lifetime value (LTV) per signup cohort for the subscription service. The cohort is the UTC month of signup. For each cohort and each month_offset from 0 up to the latest offset observable in the data (the month of the latest payment overall), output the cumulative successful-payment revenue of the cohort through that offset and ltv_per_user = cumulative_revenue / cohort_size, where cohort_size is ALL users who signed up in the cohort month (payers or not). Offsets with no payments must still appear, carrying the cumulative value forward. Output columns: cohort_month (DATE), month_offset (INT64), cohort_size (INT64), cumulative_revenue (FLOAT64), ltv_per_user (FLOAT64, 2 decimals).
edge_cases: Offset 1 has no successful payments but must appear with the carried-forward cumulative value
Users who never paid (3 and 4) remain in the cohort_size denominator
Failed and refunded payments are excluded
Younger cohorts have fewer observable offsets; no rows beyond the latest data month
common_failure_modes: FM3: Dividing by the number of paying users instead of the full cohort overstates LTV (20/1 instead of 20/4)
FM2: Running sum over only the offsets that have payments skips offset 1, leaving a hole in the curve
FM1: INNER JOIN users to payments shrinks the cohort to payers
